card.name: Link after mother/father before relation
card.fires_on: The linking word "of" or "-to" right after a family or role noun such as mother, father, brother, parents or mentor. It is strongest in "mother-to-child", "mother-to-be" and "father of".

card.plain: It fires on the small link word right after words like mother or father, as in "father of" or "mother-to-child".
